flkforge: hello in DIR

Written:
  Dockerfile     written  base-alpine, packages, start-script, volume
  flk.toml       written  env, http-service, vm, volume
  start.sh       written  start-script: yours from now on: flkforge won't overwrite it
  flkforge.toml  written  the recipe: what to render, and hashes of what was written

Ports: VM 8080/tcp (http, machine IP only)

flk config show: not checked with flk: file does not exist

Not in effect yet:
  - Port 8080 is on the machine's IP only (flk status shows it), not on a host port: set host_port to forward one

For you to run, in DIR:
  flk launch --no-deploy            # registers hello with flk, without building or starting anything
  flk volumes create data --size 1  # [[mounts]] needs the volume before the first deploy (one per machine)
  flk deploy                        # builds the image and starts the app; it waits for the health checks
